Block-arrow directions are trimmed (D445), so `( right , left )` reads `right`, `left`; v12 kept the blanks (and line breaks) and so matched no direction and drew no arrow (MIGRATION.md, #554).
A `class` before the block it names no longer hides the block (D442): v12 created a hidden `na` block, so the later declaration counted as a repeat and was never placed (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`class a, b` trims its ids (D442): v12 looked up ` b`, made a hidden block of it and replaced the real `b`, which lost the class (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`columns 0` counts as `columns auto` (D445), with one BLOCK_SIZE_INVALID warning: the level's columns are -1 where v12 kept 0 and threw at render (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`block:a --> b … end`: the composite is `a`, and the edge and `b` sit next to it (GAPS #554, pending a D-id, D440); v12 spread the header chain into a composite with no id and lost the edge.
A composite opened a second time adds the second body to the first, as D442 does for a leaf (GAPS #554, pending a D-id, D440); v12 lost the second body's new blocks.

An `a --> b --> c` chain declares a, b and c and keeps both edges (D442); v12's grammar read the first link's result as a node, so it dropped a, b and a→b and added a block `undefined` (MIGRATION.md, #554).

A block first written as a leaf and then opened as `block:id … end` keeps its place and adopts the children (D442); v12 put the children on an object it never stored, so they were lost (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`root` is an ordinary id (D442): v12 seeded its DB with its own top-level `root`, so a block `root` merged into it and was never drawn (MIGRATION.md, #554).

A span `:0` counts as `:1` (D445), with one BLOCK_SIZE_INVALID warning; v12 kept 0 and drew NaN (MIGRATION.md, #554).

A `class` before the block it names no longer hides the block (D442): v12 created a hidden `na` block, so the later declaration counted as a repeat and was never placed (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`class a, b` trims its ids (D442): v12 looked up ` b`, made a hidden block of it and replaced the real `b`, which lost the class (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`columns 0` counts as `columns auto` (D445), with one BLOCK_SIZE_INVALID warning: the level's columns are -1 where v12 kept 0 and threw at render (MIGRATION.md, #554).
`block:a --> b … end`: the composite is `a`, and the edge and `b` sit next to it (GAPS #554, pending a D-id, D440); v12 spread the header chain into a composite with no id and lost the edge.
A composite opened a second time adds the second body to the first, as D442 does for a leaf (GAPS #554, pending a D-id, D440); v12 lost the second body's new blocks.

A `space` over 100,000 cells is cut to 100,000 (D445, R-SEC-5), with one BLOCK_TRUNCATED warning; v12 kept every cell (one cloned block each). This changes accept/reject too: 12.2.0 rejects a spacer over 16,777,214 cells with `Map maximum size exceeded` (its block map holds at most 2^24 entries, the top level and the spacer itself included, so the bound is lower when there are other blocks), as `space:100000000`, which v13 accepts (MIGRATION.md, #554).
